name: Point Cloud Voxelization via Discretization and Accumulation
aliases: Coverage Estimation and View Frustum Construction
binary occupancy grid from point cloud
definition: A method to convert a 3D point cloud into a binary voxel grid (occupancy grid) by discretizing point coordinates into a regular grid and marking voxels as occupied if they contain at least one point.
summary: Point Cloud Voxelization via Discretization and Accumulation converts irregular 3D point clouds into binary occupancy grids by binning coordinates, distinguished by its direct accumulation approach rather than feature storage.
